items.title: A spin plan that failed to turn
items.summary: While Bangladesh are putting on a brave face heading into day five, their tactical gambles have repeatedly backfired. A draw is now the most positive result they can realistically hope for in the Sylhet Test, and even that would leave them losing the series. Their decision to back three spin options has once again failed to deliver.

items.title: 'Chasing it is possible': Hridoy keeps faith in Tigers despite uphill task
